eyebrow.zh: 本地离线 · 音色不上云 · 一条命令
eyebrow.en: Local & offline · Voice on device · One command

headline.zh: 用你自己的音色朗读中文
headline.en: Read Chinese in your own voice

sub.zh: 一段 5 秒的参考音频就能锁定家人音色，全程本地离线合成，音色生物特征从不上云。
sub.en: Lock a family voice from a 5-second sample and synthesize entirely offline — your voice biometric never leaves the machine.

hero.command: qwenvoice say --voice ref.wav --ref-text '今天天气真好' --text '你好' -o hello.mp3

title.en: Your voice stays on your device

body.zh: 云端语音合成要你上传家人的音色样本——那是生物特征。QwenVoice 全程本地离线，参考音频从不离开你的机器。
body.en: Cloud voice synthesis asks you to upload your family's voice sample — that's a biometric. QwenVoice runs entirely offline; your reference audio never leaves your machine.

body.zh: 录一段家人说话的参考音频并记下那句转写，音色即被锁定。随后任意一段中文都能用这个音色读出来。
body.en: Record a family member speaking and note the transcript — the voice is locked. Any passage of Chinese can then be read in that voice.

title.en: Runs on the laptop you own

body.zh: 不需要昂贵的显卡，模型在普通笔记本上本地运行，一条命令安装即用。
body.en: No expensive GPU needed — the model runs locally on an ordinary laptop, ready with a single install command.

body.zh: 不用担心每次合成音色都变——QwenVoice 为每次合成生成专属音色指纹，同样的输入永远读出同一个音色。
body.en: No more voice shifting between renders — QwenVoice generates a dedicated voice fingerprint for every synthesis, so the same input always yields the same voice.

headline.zh: 用家人的声音 读出你的文字
headline.en: Hear your text in your family's voice

sub.zh: 一条命令安装，5 秒参考音频，本地离线合成你的第一段克隆音色。
sub.en: One command to install, a 5-second sample, then synthesize your first cloned-voice segment offline.

tag.zh: 本地离线中文音色克隆 · 音色不上云
tag.en: Local offline Chinese voice cloning · Voice stays on device
